query: SELECT mm.uid, mm.message_id FROM mailbox_messages mm JOIN messages m ON m.id = mm.message_id AND m.tenant_id = mm.tenant_id JOIN message_keywords k ON k.message_id = mm.message_id AND k.tenant_id = mm.tenant_id WHERE mm.tenant_id = $1 AND mm.mailbox_id = $2 AND m.user_id = $3 AND k.keyword = $4 ORDER BY mm.uid ASC
